## NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework and Its Generative AI Profile

NIST released the AI Risk Management Framework 1.0 in January 2023 as a voluntary, broad framework to help organizations incorporate trustworthiness considerations across the AI lifecycle, from design and development to use and evaluation.

In July 2024, NIST published AI 600-1, a cross-sector companion profile focused on generative AI. The publications are related but distinct in scope: the profile focuses on one class of AI, while the framework is broader. Its companion status does not mean that AI 600-1 replaces the AI Risk Management Framework.
